notes:
What's new in 0.1.118:
- Parental controls: when a parent makes a profile's limits stricter while that person is already watching, the video now stops at the next piece instead of carrying on, also over Beebo Relay. The summary now says "On, but no limits are set yet" when no limit is set.
- Movie Night: a TV browser can only take over a waiting Movie Night room with the four-digit code shown in Beebo on this PC, and Beebo shows a notice when a TV took over a room. The TV lobby works better on an upright phone, a removed guest is told they were removed, and game names are translated.
- Jellyfin apps: collection pictures follow what each person may see, posters refresh properly, a show or season counts as watched when its episodes are, Continue Watching and Latest episodes page correctly, the not-a-favourite filter works, and a low-bitrate film that needs converting plays instead of giving a server error.
- Movies and TV: a new 4K or second copy of a film shows under New, missing posters no longer stop the rest of the New list, Details on a poster is a visible keyboard button, a film replaced while it was being prepared for streaming does not reuse the old copy, actor photos that failed once are fetched again, subtitles with arrows in the dialogue show correctly, and a show you had open that leaves the library takes you back to the library.
- Away from home and Relay: a speed limit you set for a member stays in place when their video changes quality. The Relay switch and cards now show one true state, and the confirmation keeps the offer you clicked.
- Users and sharing: the home computer can accept Campsite guest sign-up requests from a newer phone app (not published yet). The share-code status refreshes by itself, the folder picker lists each folder once, and the security log events are translated.
- Music, radio, podcasts, photos and Picture Frame: radio keeps playing when more songs arrive, a removed radio favourite stays removed, four podcast follow and download fixes, arrow keys on a playing video in Photos no longer change the photo, and the whole frame photo ends above the clock and note strip.
- Also: Settings search finds Kitchen announcements, a clock change no longer pauses them for long, ntfy setup keeps what you typed, the Converter stops when Beebo closes, only the top dialog answers Tab and Escape, read aloud reports a failure instead of staying silent, and the FFmpeg licence notice matches the shipped build.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.116 and 0.1.117 were private test builds. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not part of this release.
- Release source commit 6c623b8f0.

- Published: Jan 1, 2099, 12:00 AM Eastern.
